A shared platform

How NDD stays fair to every member
  1. 01

    Advisory Circle

    One member from each of the six pillars gives members a voice in programmes and keeps the pillars balanced.

  2. 02

    Every pillar on stage

    Every major NDD event features at least three pillars, so no single discipline takes over.

  3. 03

    Open about interests

    Where a founder's own firm is a member, we say so openly. NDD is a shared platform, not one company's vehicle.

  4. 04

    An annual report

    Each year we publish what NDD earned, what it spent and what it achieved for members.
